import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
X = rng.normal(size=(20, 2))
y = (X[:, 0] * X[:, 1] > 0).astype(float)
W1 = rng.normal(size=(2, 4)) * 0.5
b1 = np.zeros(4)
w2 = rng.normal(size=4) * 0.5
b2 = 0.0

def loss(W1):
    p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-(np.maximum(0, X @ W1 + b1) @ w2 + b2)))
    return -np.mean(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p))


Z=X@W1+b1;H=np.maximum(0,Z);p=1/(1+np.exp(-(H@w2+b2)))
g=(X.T@(np.outer((p-y)/len(y),w2)*(Z>0)))[0,1]
plus=W1.copy();minus=W1.copy();plus[0,1]+=1e-5;minus[0,1]-=1e-5
n=(loss(plus)-loss(minus))/(2e-5)
rel_err=abs(g-n)/(abs(g)+abs(n))
g_analytic=round(float(g),6);g_numeric=round(float(n),6)
